channel.title: Kenya - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Kenya, every source cited.

item.title: Ruto appoints former minister and ex-senator to state agencies
item.description: President William Ruto has appointed a former minister and an ex-senator to lead state agencies as he streamlines government operations.

item.title: Kenya threatens Africa CDC action over Saudi travel ban
item.description: Nairobi protests disproportionate Ebola travel restrictions that suspend visas and bar arrivals.

item.title: Sifuna demands transparency on Mrima Hills mining project
item.description: Linda Mwananchi Movement party leader questions benefits for Kwale residents from rare earth mineral extraction.

item.title: Taita Taveta targets US$4.3 million potato industry growth
item.description: The county government is improving access to certified seeds, farmer training, and market linkages to boost production.

item.title: First body recovered from Nairobi building collapse
item.description: 16 people remain missing after an 18-storey building collapsed in Nairobi last Friday.
